Video.PiAddress_comment: IP address or host name of the Raspberry Pi; 'local' runs the encoder on this PC
Video.PiUser_comment: user on the Pi; the PC logs in with an SSH key (ssh-copy-id user@pi once)
Video.PcAddress_comment: this PC's address as the Pi sees it (the Pi sends the video there)
Video.UdpPort_comment: UDP port on this PC for the encoded video (MPEG-TS)
Video.VideoShare_percent_comment: share of the transport-block payload rate given to the video, %
Video.MaxHeight_comment: largest resolution row of the operating table to use (Pi 4: 540)
Video.MaxQueue_ms_comment: video waiting for the link beyond this is dropped (oldest first)
Video.Source_comment: PiFile (the video file on the Pi, looped) or PiCamera (not implemented yet)
Video.PiVideoFile_comment: path on the Pi (~/ = the Pi user's home)
Video.Loopback_comment: 1: no Pluto; the packets are unpacked on this PC and played with ffplay
Video.LoopbackDrop_percent_comment: loopback only: share of blocks dropped as failed CRCs, %
